text:
Maya Patel: quick QA on Compliance > Privacy mock — few UX nits: encryption badge copy, audit search placeholder, retention SR announcements.

Samir Khan: noted. which badge copy is wrong?

Maya Patel: pill shows 'Encrypted' and tooltip says 'Managed by Redwood KMS' even for BYOK rows.

Olivia Reed: pill variants: 'Encrypted (Redwood)' / 'Encrypted (Customer)'. tooltip: expand to 'Redwood-managed key' / 'Customer-managed (BYOK)'.

Sophie Chen: A11y: pill not in tab order before actions and has no focus ring. add visible outline and aria-label 'Encryption: customer-managed'. also retention slider aria-live reads just number — should read 'Retention: 30 days'.

Alex Gómez: region selector: prefer user's saved region first, then latency-sorted. mock shows alphabetical.

Maya Patel: audit placeholder says 'search events...'. suggest 'Search events, user email, or key ID'.

Samir Khan: modal CTA issue: 'Enable encryption' both enables and binds key. split into 'Enable (Redwood-managed)' and 'Bind key & enable' with helper line 'Pick a key or use Redwood-managed. Encrypts stored data.'

Olivia Reed: short helper: 'Choose your key or use Redwood-managed. Encrypts stored artifacts.'

Sophie Chen: contrast: badge hover fails 3.2:1. target >=4.5:1. can darken text ~18%.

design-bot: new mock: https://figma.com/file/rz/privacy-v7 includes fixes. please review.

Maya Patel: aim to ship in next console patch. reviews by EOD pls.

Samir Khan: I'll review after 5pm PT.

Olivia Reed: copy + a11y pass EOD.

Sophie Chen: keyboard walkthrough tomorrow AM.

Alex Gómez: will add contrast regression test in QA checklist.
